{{DISPLAYTITLE:strangewayes}}
'''strangewayes''' is a Star Wars CCG Forums user who announced and published a 600 dpi scanning project for [[Star Wars CCG]] cards.<ref name="t65510" />

== Service ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Dates !! Service
|-
| 20 May 2017 &ndash; 21 February 2023 || HiRez scanning project: a 600 dpi image archive of [[Star Wars CCG]] cards, published in a Google Drive folder<ref name="t65510" /><ref name="drive" />
|}

== HiRez scans on this wiki ==
The wiki holds 3,551 files from the project, uploaded as WebP; each File page names the original TIFF in the project's Drive folder.<ref name="drive" />

* '''Scans of printed cards''' (2,573 files): his 600 dpi scans of Decipher cards, of the two card backs and of six Players Committee Demo Deck promos, in [[:Category:High-res card scans]]. On every file the outer black border is a uniform digital fill, the same on all his files (even on cards printed with a white border); the inside of the card's frame is the scanned card. Card articles show Decipher's own image as the main picture and link his scan under it as the '''High-Res Scan'''. Where no Decipher image shows a printing as printed, his scan is the main picture, with a note: [[Electrobinoculars]], [[Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm]], [[Leia Seeker]], [[Warrant Officer M'Kae]], [[Artoo (Jabba's Palace)]], [[Lando With Vibro-Ax]], [[Ki-Adi-Mundi]], the 7 side of [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe]] and the reverse of [[Jabba's Prize (Reflections II)]].

=== Re-made cards ===
Part of the project is re-made work rather than scans. These files are kept, in [[:Category:Strangewayes re-made card images]], but are not shown or linked on card articles (decision of 28 November 2026):
* '''Two-Player cards re-coloured''' (13 files): Premiere and Empire Strikes Back Two-Player Introductory Game cards, which Decipher printed with a white border, re-coloured to a black border.
* '''Print-ready errata cards''' (530 files): fan re-sets of cards with their errata text and an "E" mark (512 errata cards and 18 interim "E" cards). Neither Decipher nor the Players Committee published these images.
* '''Virtual card renders''' (435 files): print-ready renders of Players Committee virtual cards from Virtual Sets 0–9, re-made by him for printing.
